title: Architecture Failure Model and State Machine

walkthroughs.name: Interrupted Document Upload
steps: Client begins multipart stream to /api/process-document.
Network connection abruptly severs before stream completion.
Express intake handler catches socket close error.
Unfinished file at storage/private/temp/{jobId}.upload.tmp is unlinked immediately.
No database transaction is committed; zero orphaned records created.

walkthroughs.name: OCR Worker Execution Timeout
steps: Worker claims job with a 300-second lease token.
Worker encounters pathological image and stalls beyond 300 seconds without heartbeat.
Orchestrator lease monitor detects lease_expires_at < now().
Orchestrator sends SIGKILL to runaway worker subprocess.
If job attempt < 3: increments attempt counter, resets lease token, reverts state to pending.
If job attempt == 3: transitions state to failed with ERR_POISON_PILL and quarantines.

walkthroughs.name: OCR Worker Process Crash
steps: Worker subprocess terminates unexpectedly with non-zero exit code (e.g. OOM SIGKILL 137).
Orchestrator childProcess 'exit' handler catches abnormal termination.
Orchestrator inspects attempt count in SQLite.
If attempt < 3: resets worker_id to null, reverts status to pending for next available worker.
If attempt == 3: marks job failed with code ERR_WORKER_CRASH_EXHAUSTED.

walkthroughs.name: Orchestrator Server Crash & Restart
steps: Server host suffers abrupt power loss or SIGKILL while 5 jobs are in processing.
All in-memory process state is lost.
On server reboot, StartupReconciler runs before opening HTTP listener.
Reconciler executes atomic query: SELECT * FROM ocr_jobs WHERE status IN ('claimed', 'processing') AND lease_expires_at < strftime('%s','now').
Orphaned jobs with attempts < 3 are safely reverted to 'pending'.
Orphaned jobs with attempts >= 3 are transitioned to 'failed' (poison pill).
Zero dependence on ephemeral job queues or in-memory lists.

walkthroughs.name: Database Busy Contention & Partial Commit Rollback
steps: Multiple workers attempt concurrent field result writes, triggering transient SQLITE_BUSY.
SQLite busy_timeout (5000ms) permits queueing.
If timeout expires before lock acquisition, transaction throws SQLiteBusyException.
Orchestrator catches exception and invokes ROLLBACK TRANSACTION.
Partial extracted fields are rolled back completely from database.
Worker retains lease and retries write with exponential jittered backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms).
